outcome: expression of 730 immune-related genes (complement, toll-like receptor (TLR) associated genes, TLR1, TLR4)
presence of Mast cells and M2 macrophages
cohort: Placenta samples were collected from healthy pregnancies (n=13-20), early-onset preeclampsia pregnancies (n=13-19), and late-onset preeclampsia pregnancies (n=6-10).
finding: Early-onset preeclampsia placentas displayed reduced expression of complement and toll-like receptor (TLR) associated genes (TLR1 and TLR4), along with decreased mast cells and M2 macrophages, alterations which were absent in late-onset preeclampsia placentas.
gest_age: Early-onset preeclampsia (<34 weeks of gestation), Late-onset preeclampsia (>=34 weeks of gestation)
